about: The DSH runtime profile a patch is applied to: the files a launcher *would* allow, so a
reader can see where an edit to the profile lands (docs/adapter-spec.md section 3).
Declared, not enforced -- nothing in this repository reads this file, and no edit is
refused on the strength of it. The platform records which declared component an edit
touched instead (harnessgrad/components.py). Profile root, and the DSH_HOME-versus-HOME

apply.note: DSH resolves the profile root from DSH_HOME, not HOME (measured §186.2): a launcher that sets only HOME makes the patch silently inert while the task still succeeds.

smoke.note: -h prints usage without loading the plugin tree, and --dump-config does not resolve modules, so neither alone is a smoke (§186.1).
